panels.title: Restarts
panels.description: Container restarts over the time range.

panels.title: Last terminated
panels.description: Why each container last stopped, for containers that have restarted.

panels.title: Memory of limit

targets.expr: max(sum by (pod, container) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{container!="",container!="POD",namespace="$deployment"}) / on (pod, container) sum by (pod, container) (kube_pod_container_resource_limits{job="prometheus-kube-state-metrics",namespace="$deployment",resource="memory"}))

panels.description: The container closest to its memory limit. At 100% the kernel OOM-kills it.

panels.title: Bucket
panels.description: As of the exporter's last read of this bucket, which can lag by minutes.

panels.title: PVC provisioned
panels.description: Requested size, not usage. local-path enforces no quota, and kubelet reports no usage for its volumes.

panels.title: CPU by container
panels.description: Cores, stacked by container: the app and the platform's sidecars.

panels.title: CPU throttling
panels.description: Share of scheduling periods in which the container hit its CPU limit.

panels.title: Pod network
panels.description: All pod traffic, including the app's own database and object storage traffic. Out is drawn below the axis.

panels.title: Public HTTP traffic
panels.description: Request and response bodies as Traefik counted them at the edge.

panels.title: Requests by status
panels.description: Everything Traefik routed for this deployment, including requests sign-in turned away.

panels.title: Connections by state
panels.description: Server connections, which the pooler (transaction mode) holds on the app's behalf.

panels.title: Statement time
panels.description: Time spent executing statements, divided by transactions. Per-query timings need pg_stat_statements, which is not enabled.

panels.title: PVC provisioned
panels.description: Requested size per claim, not usage: local-path enforces no quota, and kubelet reports no usage for its volumes.

panels.title: Pod logs
panels.description: Every container of the deployment, the platform's sidecars included. Narrow with Container, Release and Search.

panels.title: Traefik access log
panels.description: Requests at the edge, including those sign-in turned away. Narrow with Status and Search.

panels.title: Platform log lines for this deployment
Reconciler, builds and housekeeping
panels.description: Platform lines that name this deployment's ID. Scans every platform line in the range, so the row stays collapsed until opened.
